# @trysac/problem-details

> TypeScript library for Node.js 20+ that builds, parses and documents RFC 9457 problem+json errors from a typed catalog, with templated details, leak-safe error mapping and Markdown docs. Published as ES modules with type declarations, no runtime dependencies, MIT licensed.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example and public API
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test files and how coverage works
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, defended and not defended

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and effort metrics
